reason: Replace locator proxy truth with context-reviewed reference labels. Repair invalid F2 evidence without rewriting the original contract.
exposure: The prior SIDH population and keyword results have been inspected. Reuse is a retrospective development study, not a fresh confirmatory test.
freeze_requires: Exact source-checked unit manifests, versions, claim inventories and exclusions
Calibration and evaluation partitions grouped by work, with no repeated passages used to reach the minimum
Pinned model IDs, vendors, request settings, prompts, parser and scorer hashes for every role
Separate permitted-input manifests for reviewer A, reviewer B, labeller, M3 and the M4 declarant
Timestamped publication of the complete run bundle before any model evaluation call
Immutable request and response receipts with failures retained; no fallback and no overwritten attempts
Frozen per-work sampling, abstention, effort counting and bootstrap rules

bounded_run.source_requirement: Exact passage, source bytes hash, text version, claim IDs and location. Verify the passage against local source bytes before a run. Store text outside the repository.
bounded_run.missing_rule: Retain every planned unit and its missing reason. Do not refill or change the sample after seeing labels. An unmet minimum stops the run.
bounded_run.reference: Two separate model invocations on different vendors. Neither sees the other response or method predictions. Their agreement is a simulated reference, not proof or expert ground truth.
bounded_run.calibration: Evaluate a third labeller against context-reviewed reference labels. Locator extraction is a separate diagnostic. Kappa must be defined and at least 0.60 on at least 100 eligible units.
bounded_run.pilot: Report disagreement, unknown coverage and effective sample size. More than 0.20 disagreement on at least 60 reviewable units stops evaluation. Do not tune for agreement.
bounded_run.untrusted_text: Paper text is data, never instructions. Reviewer and declarant calls have no tools, network, filesystem access or credentials. Parse only the pinned response schema; retain failure instead of running supplied commands.

comparison.population: Freeze the claim-level universe before inspecting method predictions. M1 and M2 need actual pinned citation edges. A missing two-step graph yields no M2 score.
comparison.order: Collect and seal M1/M2/M3 first. Collect M4 next. Run reference reviewers separately. Score only after every receipt passes validation.
comparison.m3: Uses pinned text, citation context, locator and S2 intent inputs. No access to reviewer labels or M4 declarations.
comparison.m4: A separate declarant receives only the writing-time view. It sees no fall dossier, future repair, reviewer labels or M3 output. The propagation stage receives the same fall scope as M3 only after declarations are sealed. Known-case model memory remains a limitation.
comparison.report: Separate confusion counts, false alarms, missed dependencies, coverage and per-reviewer sensitivity. Use common support and report excluded and disputed IDs. Undefined ratios are null. Never pool OpenAlex and S2 denominators.
comparison.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by citing work, 2000 resamples, 95 percent percentile interval, seed 20261004. Report per-case values. No superiority claim from agreement alone.
comparison.effort: Record declaration and correction calls, configuration and setup actions, supplier and adopter code, model tokens and cost. Record human effort as unmeasured. Keep API waiting outside offline accuracy scores; report acquisition wall time separately.
comparison.decision: An F1 difference M4 minus M3 at or below 0.05 under the agreed subset or either reviewer supports the no-added-accuracy result. Missing effort or uncertainty prevents an adoption claim.

replay.order: Freeze a replay oracle from reviewed dependencies. Run the equipped reference before Kyoei with identical evidence, authority and automation.
replay.story: A contributes a method claim, B contributes a dependent analysis, C helps publish a joint output. A scoped challenge opens a reassessment task. A supported correction reaches all affected owners. A reviewer records dissent or confirms the repair. A replacement restores permitted use while unrelated work continues.
replay.limits: A challenge does not prove an entire paper invalid. A managed-use refusal does not revoke public bytes or public licenses. No real researcher is assigned a simulated opinion.

branch_map: Use needs-reassessment, contested, repaired, no-identified-dependency or unknown, with dated evidence. No detected dependency is not proof of soundness.
data: Use the existing S2 shared rate gate and complete offline snapshots. Preserve the existing no-full-text-release and source access rules. No new dependencies.
